image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of the head and upper neck of a Nile crocodile resting on dark soil. The image focuses heavily on the textured, armored skin (scutes) and the closed eye. The snout is visible with teeth interlocking along the jawline. The lighting is bright, casting shadows that emphasize the rough texture of the osteoderms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers to a point consistent with a V-shape, distinguishing it from the U-shape of an alligator. The head structure appears broad and robust.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The lower teeth are clearly visible protruding upwards even though the mouth is closed, demonstrating the characteristic interlocking arrangement of crocodilians.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is located on the top ridge of the skull (dorsal). While the pupil shape is hard to resolve at this resolution, the positioning and the presence of the eyelid structure are correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A nostril opening is clearly visible at the anterior end of the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head and immediate neck/shoulder area are visible; the full elongation of the body cannot be verified in this crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture shows distinct, raised, irregular bony plates (scutes) typical of crocodile armor, particularly behind the eye and on the neck.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of greys and earthy browns, and the texture is visibly rough and calcified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral (belly) side is not visible in this dorsal/lateral view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs or feet are visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is outside the field of view.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The transition between the crocodile's neck scales and the background elements (possibly eggs or rocks) is slightly soft and lacks clear boundary definition, suggesting minor generation blur or fusion.
The edge of the lower jaw blends slightly into the soil particles without a sharp occlusion boundary, a common subtle artifact in AI-generated close-ups.
